early_attack_detection.definition: Catch attacks as fast as possible after onset; false alarms may rise but must stay within the operations budget of 1.0 false alarms per hour.
early_attack_detection.success: Lower per-incident detection delay, with false alarms <= 1.0/hour.
phrasings: catch attacks earlier
I want the fastest possible attack detection
detect intrusions as soon as they start
reduce detection delay, alarms can be noisy
early attack detection please
flag attacks immediately even if you are sometimes wrong
speed of detection is the priority right now
we are under threat - catch anything fast

minimize_false_alarms.definition: Reduce false alarms as far as possible while the known (DNS-type) attack remains genuinely detected (a sustained detection, not a blip).
minimize_false_alarms.success: Lower false alarms per hour; the DNS-type incident must still be genuinely detected.
phrasings: fewer false alarms
stop crying wolf, only alert when it is real
reduce the false positives
the console is too noisy, quiet it down
minimise false alarm rate
I only want alarms that are genuinely attacks
cut the alert noise but keep catching real attacks
operators are ignoring alerts - make alarms trustworthy

balanced_operation.definition: A sensible default trade-off between missed attacks and false alarms, within 5.0 false alarms per hour.
balanced_operation.success: High balanced accuracy (MCC) at <= 5.0 false alarms/hour.
phrasings: balanced operation
just give me a sensible default
normal operation mode
balance false alarms against missed attacks
standard monitoring posture
reset to a reasonable middle ground
no special priority - balanced performance

defend_unknown_attacks.definition: Prioritise detecting attack types never seen in training, accepting substantially more false alarms - up to 25 per hour.
defend_unknown_attacks.success: Novel attack types (like GTP-U) are detected at all, within 25 false alarms/hour.
phrasings: defend against unknown attacks
protect us from zero-day attacks
catch attack types we have never seen before
assume the next attack is completely novel
prepare for unknown threats
novel attack detection is the priority
we expect an unfamiliar attack vector - be ready
